rows.text: You accidentally step into a ground trap made of branches and leaves — the type you believe to be used only by the most old-fashioned hunter on planet Bled. You get to your feet, and the entrance of a nest is before you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Obtain 1 Preservation Blessing of 1- to 2-star rarity and 1 Propagation Blessing of 1- to 2-star rarity.
Enter the Insect Nest and snuff them out!
Enter 3 battles with the Swarm and obtain 3 random Blessings of 1- to 2-star rarity.
Go deeper into the insect nest.

Slowly, you make your way into the insect nest. As you brush off the eggs hanging upside down from the roof, you discover to your amazement that newborns within the translucent egg sacs are scratching their still unopened compound eyes with their antennae.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You find an astonishing sight at the end of the nest. On a throne atop a pile of hundreds of "egg sacs," "THEY" are sleeping soundly.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A day passes when you blink once. You feel you are looking at the sleeping form of Tayzzyronth, the Imperator Insectorum, over and over, hoping that THEY will open THEIR eyes and look at you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The first egg sac softly ruptures, and new life blooms.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Soon, a voice begins to ring in your head... Tay█zzy█ ██ro█n█ █th██... The long wait destroyed you, and you flee in a hurry.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Stop at the entrance of the nest.
You believe your life doesn't need adventures... More importantly, you dread to face Tay█zzy█ ██ro█n█ █th██'s █ █childre███ ████...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You have obtained some Cosmic Fragments.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
